gloss: as of; with this; effective from

definitions.gloss: as of; with this; effective from
definitions.explanation: A very formal expression used to indicate a point in time or event that marks a transition, ending, or official change. The polite form of をもって.

examples.japanese: これをもちまして、{閉会|へいかい}とします。
examples.english: With this, we will close the session.

examples.japanese: {本日|ほんじつ}をもちまして、{営業|えいぎょう}を{終了|しゅうりょう}いたします。
examples.english: As of today, we will cease operations.

examples.japanese: {三月|さんがつ}{末日|まつじつ}をもちまして、{当店|とうてん}は{閉店|へいてん}させていただきます。
examples.english: As of the end of March, our store will be closing.

notes:
The polite/formal version of をもって. Derived from {持|も}つ (to hold/have) in its polite -ます form. Used in formal announcements, ceremonies, and official notices to mark a specific time or event as a boundary.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- これをもちまして: with this (closing a meeting/event)
- {本日|ほんじつ}をもちまして: as of today
- [date]をもちまして: effective from [date]

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- をもちまして{閉会|へいかい}とします: we hereby close the meeting
- をもちまして{終了|しゅうりょう}します: will end as of
- をもちまして{退任|たいにん}いたします: will resign as of

FORMALITY LEVELS:
- をもって: formal
- をもちまして: very formal (polite form)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- をもって: as of, with — the plain formal version
- で: at, with — the everyday equivalent
- を{最後|さいご}に: ending with — similar idea of marking a final point
- を{限|かぎ}りに: as of, starting from — emphasizes a cutoff point
